Wir bei Insurgo

Wir bei Insurgo sind nicht nur ein Technologie-Unternehmen. Wir sind Innovatoren, die den Weg für digitale Lösungen in der Versicherungswirtschaft ebnen. Hunderte Maklerbüros arbeiten bereits mit unserer Software, unser Postfach Plus nimmt ihnen bis zu 80 Prozent ihres Verwaltungsaufwands ab, und unsere Kunden bewerten uns über 900 Mal.

Wir entwickeln Insurgo zunehmend mit KI-Agenten. Nicht als Spielerei und nicht im Blindflug: Agenten übernehmen einen wachsenden Teil der Umsetzung, du gibst die Richtung vor, prüfst, entscheidest und verantwortest das Ergebnis. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Software Engineer entwickelst du unsere Plattform in voller Breite weiter. Du arbeitest fachlich eng mit unserem Product Management zusammen und berichtest an den Geschäftsführer.

  • Plattform weiterentwickeln: Du verantwortest Features vom Rails-Backend über die REST-API bis ins Angular-Frontend, von der Idee bis zum Release.
  • Agentic Engineering: Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding-Agenten wie Cursor, Claude Code und GitHub Copilot. Du zerlegst Aufgaben so, dass Agenten sie zuverlässig umsetzen, und sicherst die Qualität über Code Review und Tests.
  • Wissen für Mensch und Agent: Du baust mit uns eine lebende Wissensbasis über Code, Architektur und Fachlichkeit auf, mit der Entwickler und Agenten gleichermaßen arbeiten können.
  • KI im Produkt: Du entwickelst unseren Insurgo Agent und weitere KI-Funktionen weiter, die Maklern spürbar Arbeit abnehmen.
  • Integrationen: Du kümmerst dich um Branchenschnittstellen wie BiPRO und VEMA, E-Mail-Anbindungen, digitale Post und elektronische Signatur.
  • Stabiler Betrieb: Wir releasen täglich. Du sorgst mit dafür, dass unsere Plattform dabei sicher, schnell und verlässlich läuft.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Mandantenfähige SaaS-Plattform, jeder Mandant mit eigenem Datenbankschema
  • Backend: Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, Action Cable
  • Frontend: Angular mit TypeScript
  • API: REST/JSON mit OpenAPI und Webhooks, genutzt von unserem Frontend, von Kunden und von Automationen wie Zapier
  • Mobile: zwei Flutter-Apps für iOS und Android
  • Daten: PostgreSQL, Redis, S3
  • Add-ons: Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp Web, Thunderbird und Missive
  • Hosting: AWS in Frankfurt, hochverfügbar und DSGVO-konform
  • Arbeitsweise: Kanban in Jira, Pull Requests und Code Review in Bitbucket, tägliche Releases auf Staging und Production

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Senior-Erfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre professionell Webanwendungen entwickelt und Verantwortung für Systeme im Produktivbetrieb getragen.

title: Product Engineer (Client Platform)
description:

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Product Engineer (Client Platform)

The goal is to build a minimal, usable platform that lets clients do every important action themselves. It automates what can be automated and makes the rest easy to see and act on.

Our Client Platform sits at the core of our business, so what you build will directly shape how our clients work with us every day.

title: KI-Entwickler LLM / RAG / Agenten – Python oder TypeScript (m/w/d)
description:

Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, Büros in Stuttgart und München. Aus hunderten Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstandskunden wissen wir, wie man Software baut, die im Ernstfall trägt. Seit einer Weile verschiebt sich unser Schwerpunkt Richtung KI: LLM-Anwendungen, RAG, Agenten-Systeme, die beim Kunden produktiv gehen.

Worum es geht

Unsere Kunden sind die Deutsche Bahn und IT-Dienstleister im öffentlichen Sektor, ein reguliertes Umfeld mit hohen Ansprüchen an Datenschutz, EU AI Act und Betriebssicherheit. Dort baust du KI-Lösungen in bestehende Fachanwendungen ein. Projektsprache ist Deutsch. Der Alltag läuft remote-first, Kundentermine meist in Frankfurt am Main.

Unsere Kunden stellen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten besetzt. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Aufgaben

  • Sprachmodelle in Fachanwendungen integrieren: RAG mit Retrieval und Reranking, Tool-Calling, MCP-Server, Multi-Agent-Abläufe

  • Modelle auswählen und wechselbar halten (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, offene Modelle), Governance und Datenschutz mitdenken
  • Betrieb: Container, CI/CD, Monitoring, Alerting
  • Enge Abstimmung mit Fachbereich, Architektur und Betrieb des Kunden

Das musst du mitbringen

Jeder Punkt muss im Lebenslauf nachweisbar sein.

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Softwareentwicklung in Python oder TypeScript, nach Ausbildung oder Studium
  • Mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung, die bei einem Kunden oder Arbeitgeber produktiv lief (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten), mit deinem Anteil daran
  • Docker, CI/CD und Git aus dem Projektalltag
  • Deutsch mindestens C1 in Wort und Schrift

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

Kein Muss, aber je mehr davon, desto besser:

  • Kubernetes oder OpenShift, Helm
  • MLOps-Werkzeuge (MLflow, Kubeflow, Model Serving) und klassisches ML im Produktivbetrieb
  • Vektordatenbanken, Embedding-Modelle, Reranker
  • Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock oder Vertex AI
  • EU AI Act, ISO 27001, Barrierefreiheit
  • Erfahrung bei Bahn, Behörden oder Sozialversicherung
  • Prometheus und Grafana, ArgoCD, SAFe

Benefits

  • Echte Produktivprojekte. KI, die beim Kunden in Betrieb geht. Kein Innovation-Lab, keine Folien.
  • Remote-first in der DACH-Region. Gelegentlich vor Ort, ansonsten arbeitest du von dort, wo du gut arbeitest.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description:
About Nexoya

We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.

The role

You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.

How we build software

AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

  • Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority.

  • Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

  • Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

  • You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

  • Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

  • Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

  • Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

  • Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails.

  • Help evolve our agent harness and raise the bar for tests, reviews and documentation.

What you bring

  • [3+] years as a Backend Engineer with Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Solid API design (GraphQL or REST) and MySQL experience.

  • Experience with message brokers and running services on Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud (Azure preferred).

  • You enjoy discussing design trade-offs in writing and care about code others can maintain.

  • Fluent English.

Bonus: ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta) or attribution; AI or agent features in production (Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, MCP, RAG); LLM evaluation or observability; team use of Claude Code or similar; data pipelines; German.

What we offer

  • Real ownership in a team that takes engineering quality seriously.

Remote-first, technisch anspruchsvoll, mit viel Ownership. Wenn du Systeme bauen willst, die echte Arbeit erleichtern:

Willkommen bei easybill.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und genug Raum, um Dinge wirklich sauber zu lösen. Keine Meeting-Karaoke. Keine Konzern-Polonaise. Kein „Wir brauchen dafür noch sieben Freigaben“. Dafür: Fokus, Verantwortung, gute Tools und Menschen, die Probleme lieber lösen als verwalten.

Das ideale Profil? Du bringst tiefe PHP-/Symfony-Erfahrung mit, bist in TypeScript sattelfest und hast Lust, wie ein Founding Engineer Verantwortung zu übernehmen: pragmatisch, sauber, mit Blick fürs Ganze. Wenn dein Profil nicht jedes Kästchen erfüllt, du aber ein außergewöhnlich starker Engineer bist: Bewirb dich trotzdem und zeig uns, was du gebaut hast.

Aufgaben

Wir sind ein sehr motiviertes Engineering-Team mit viel Ownership und kurzen Wegen. Als Teil davon baust du neue Features, löst Skalierungsprobleme und übernimmst Verantwortung für komplette Projekte – von der Idee bis zum sauberen Betrieb.

Wir suchen Menschen, die nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Systeme verstehen, verbessern und die E-Rechnungslandschaft aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Unsere Hauptanwendung ist in PHP und TypeScript geschrieben. Im Bereich E-Rechnung betreiben wir zusätzlich Microservices auf der JVM mit Java und Kotlin. Dazu kommen MySQL bzw. Percona XtraDB Cluster, TiDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, MinIO, Docker und weitere Tools, die man braucht, wenn 22.000+ Unternehmen sich täglich auf stabile Prozesse verlassen. title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt TypeScript & SaaS-Plattform
description:
Gestalte die nächste Generation der Personaleinsatzplanung.

Wir von der IT Studio Rech GmbH suchen für unseren Kunden und Partner, die MEP24 Software GmbH, einen Senior Full-Stack Developer in Vollzeit.

MEP24 entwickelt Software, mit der Unternehmen ihre Mitarbeitenden passend einsetzen und ihren Arbeitsalltag besser organisieren. Seit 1996 bringt das Unternehmen Erfahrung aus der Personaleinsatzplanung mit. Heute vertrauen über 2.200 Kunden aus Apotheken, Kliniken und Handelsunternehmen auf MEP24.

Mit mina.works entwickelt MEP24 seine neue SaaS-Plattform auf einem modernen TypeScript-Stack weiter. Dafür suchen wir Dich: jemanden, der Frontend und Backend beherrscht, Architektur mitgestalten möchte und Verantwortung für durchdachte Software übernimmt. Du wirst Teil des Entwicklungsteams von MEP24 – wir begleiten die Suche und das Kennenlernen.

Aufgaben

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmanagement und Jens Gerstenecker, dem Geschäftsführer von MEP24, zusammen. Das Entwicklungsteam wächst – und Du gestaltest mit, wie Ihr zusammenarbeitet, technische Entscheidungen trefft und die Plattform weiterentwickelt.

Als Entwickler wirst Du…

  • Du entwickelst mina.works mit TypeScript, Node.js und React weiter – vom Backend bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen und entwickelst die Architektur der Plattform gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

  • Du arbeitest an verteilten Services und eventgetriebenen Abläufen mit Event Sourcing, CQRS und RabbitMQ.

  • Du entwickelst verständliche REST-APIs, arbeitest mit PostgreSQL und setzt Redis für Caching und Nachrichtenverarbeitung ein.

  • Du setzt fachliche Anforderungen in gut nutzbare Funktionen um und behältst dabei Wartbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und das Zusammenspiel der Services im Blick.

  • Du bringst Dich in den Aufbau des Entwicklungsteams ein und gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards mit.

  • Du entwickelst den Einsatz von AI-Driven Development im Team weiter und lernst im begleitenden Coaching, KI-Werkzeuge strukturiert in Deine tägliche Arbeit einzubinden.

Qualifikation

Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, verlässlich und möchtest verstehen, welches Problem eine Funktion für die Kunden löst. Du denkst lösungsorientiert, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Du arbeitest gerne in flachen Hierarchien, übernimmst Verantwortung und schätzt ein Team, in dem technische Entscheidungen gemeinsam diskutiert werden.

Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit und bewegst Dich sowohl im React-Frontend als auch im Node.js-Backend sicher.

  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit TypeScript, Node

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Share

Share is a venture-backed startup building the global marketplace for bandwidth. We enable anyone to build their own programmable internet network, in seconds. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. Only the largest tech companies have escaped this, by spending billions to build their own physical networks. Share is giving that power to everyone.

Infrastructure providers sell their services in the Share Marketplace; giving builders, AI agents and enterprises the ability to build their own global backbone via an API layer. The path, the performance, how long they need it and paying only for what they use.


The role

We are hiring a Founding Engineer to take ownership of core platform architecture as we rebuild for a system roughly 50x the scale of what we had before. You'll design and scale distributed systems from scratch (this is deep systems-architecture work, not feature development on an existing system.) You will work directly with the Head of Development and a small team of engineers to ship production systems operating at global scale.

Non-negotiable

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with real, hands-on ownership of designing and scaling a production system from scratch. You can describe specific production incidents at scale (what broke, why, and what you changed) not just system-design-interview theory.

  • Deep TypeScript/Node.js expertise. You should be able to design a NestJS microservice from scratch, not just work in one.

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills. You can design schemas for complex, high-throughput production data, write migrations, and reason about transaction isolation and locking.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar). You understand the difference between request-reply and fire-and-forget patterns and when to use each.

  • You ship. You can take a spec document and turn it into production code without waiting for someone to break it into small tasks.

Nice to have, not required: prior fintech/payments experience or blockchain/distributed-ledger exposure

AI-augmented engineering (required mindset)

We expect every engineer at Share to use AI tools as a daily part of their workflow. This is how we operate. Our entire project planning, specification, and documentation process runs through AI-assisted sessions. Our codebase includes AI-readable context file

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to lic

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
description:
About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar.

What you will achieve in your first year

  • You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview.

  • You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers.

  • You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.

What the job really looks like

  • The best engineers rarely apply. Most of your hires come from your own outreach, so a large part of your week is sourcing and candidate conversations.

  • You compete with big tech and AI companies for the same people, and you need a compelling story to win them.

  • You talk shop with engineers. You do not need to code, but you understand what a TypeScript full-stack role or an ML engineering role really involves.

title: Account executive enterprise, central europe
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for our a Berlin-based Enterprise Account Executive to bring Watershed to more companies in DACH. We’re at an inflection point: every large company is launching a sustainability program as pressure for action builds every day. You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies on Watershed and help them be effective. As a member of our Berlin-based go-to-market organisation, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product and help us build a stellar team.

You will:

  • Sell Watershed. Find your way to the right people at leading DACH companies, educate them about effective climate programs, and help them succeed with Watershed. You’ll own the full lifecycle, from first outbound to contract signature.

  • Develop the Watershed sales playbook for winning lighthouse logos —what’s the best messaging? How do we triangulate through the org? What tools do we need?—into a repeatable machine.

  • Take Watershed into new market segments.

  • Shape Watershed’s product strategy by sharing feedback from customers on the front line.

  • Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, and decarbonising their supply chain.

  • Help build the sales team.

You might be a fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of relevant account executive quota carrying experience in a SaaS organization

  • A track record of sales excellence, especially with enterprise customers (1,000-10,000 employees) at an executive level. 

  • Have experience prospecting new business in a new territory, specifically, DACH.

title: Freelancer Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native, Expo, TypeScript) m/w/d
description:
Willkommen bei easybill.

22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Mit easybill-mobile bringen wir zentrale Funktionen unserer Plattform auf iOS und Android – und suchen dich, um die App technisch und produktseitig mitzugestalten.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und Raum, um Dinge sauber zu lösen. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung: für technische Entscheidungen, durchdachte Nutzerführung und eine App, auf die sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden unterwegs verlassen können.

Das ideale Profil? Du bist Freelancer und in TypeScript, React Native und Expo richtig tief drin, verstehst die Besonderheiten mobiler Anwendungen und möchtest ein Produkt in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase entscheidend prägen. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit, um Funktionen auch auf Seiten unserer REST-API mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst easybill-mobile auf Basis von React Native, Expo und TypeScript für iOS und Android weiter. Eine technische Grundlage mit Anmeldung, Dashboard und Dokumentenübersichten ist bereits vorhanden. Darauf baust du auf und gestaltest die nächsten Schritte gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen rund um Rechnungen und Dokumente in verständliche mobile Abläufe und hochwertige native Oberflächen.
  • Du entwickelst die App-Architektur weiter und schaffst wartbare Strukturen für Navigation, wiederverwendbare Komponenten, Formulare und Datenzugriffe.
  • Du bindest unsere REST-API an und sorgst für verlässliches Datenmanagement: von typisierten Schnittstellen und Validierung bis zu Caching, Ladezuständen und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen App und Backend. Bei Bedarf erweiterst du unsere REST-API auf Basis von PHP und Symfony, damit neue mobile Funktionen durchgängig umgesetzt werden können.
  • Du arbeitest an sicherer Authentifizierung, Session-Verwaltung und dem sorgfältigen Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden- und Geschäftsdaten.
  • Du behältst Performance und Plattformbesonderheiten im Blick – auch bei wechselnden Netzverbindungen, App-Wechseln und unterschiedlichen Geräten. Barrierefreiheit und Mehrsprachigkeit gehören für dich zur Produktqualität.
  • Du sicherst Änderungen mit automatisierten Tests und prüfst das Verhalten auf Simulatoren und echten Geräten. Du gestaltest Build-, Release- und Monitoring-Prozesse bis zur Veröffentlichung in den App Stores mit.
  • Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, bringst eigene Lösungsvorschläge ein und begleitest Funktionen von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code intensiv im Entwicklungsalltag und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Korrektheit der Ergebnisse.

Unser Mobile-Stack umfasst React Native, Expo, Expo Router und TypeS

title: Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Infrastruktur nicht nur am Leben hält, sondern sie strukturiert, absichert und automatisiert.

Bei der dsb machen rund 200 Kolleg:innen jeden Tag Häuser fit für die Energiewende: im Büro, unterwegs und direkt vor Ort beim Kunden. Damit das funktioniert, braucht es eine IT, die einfach läuft. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Infrastruktur nicht nur am Leben hält, sondern sie strukturiert, absichert und automatisiert. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem kleinen Tech-Team zusammen und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alles rund um Arbeitsplatz, Netzwerk und Accounts.

Die Stelle ist mit einem hohen Onsite-Fokus in Berlin auszuführen. Kein Remote.

Aufgaben

  • M365 & Entra ID: Administration unseres Tenants mit Exchange Online, Benutzer- und Gruppenverwaltung, Lizenzen, MFA und Conditional Access.

  • Clients: Verwaltung, Bereitstellung und Absicherung von Windows- und macOS-Geräten, idealerweise zentral über ein MDM wie Intune.

  • Netzwerk: Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unseres UniFi-Netzwerks (Switching, WLAN, VLANs, VPN) im Büro.

  • Security: Umsetzung und Pflege von Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Endpoint-Security, Patch-Management und Backup-Konzepten.

  • SaaS & Cloud: Administration von Pipedrive (Nutzer, Rechte, Integrationen) sowie Unterstützung beim Account- und Rechtemanagement in AWS.

  • On- & Offboarding: Saubere, möglichst automatisierte Prozesse vom ersten Arbeitstag bis zum letzten.

  • Support: 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support für unsere Kolleg:innen, pragmatisch, freundlich und lösungsorientiert.

  • Dokumentation & Automatisierung: Du hältst fest, was du baust, und automatisierst, was sich wiederholt.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, ein relevantes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Berufserfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft 365 und Entra ID.

  • Erfahrung mit der Verwaltung von Windows- und macOS-Clients.

  • Solide Netzwerkgrundlagen (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN), idealerweise mit UniFi.

  • Sicherheitsbewusstsein und Verständnis für Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement.

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Scripting (z. B. PowerShell, Bash oder Python).

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, behältst den Überblick und erklärst Technik so, dass sie jeder versteht.

Nice-to-have

• Erfahrung mit Intune bzw. Apple Business Manager

• Erfahrung mit AWS (IAM, Organizations) oder Terraform

• Erfahrung mit CRM-Administration, idealerweise Pipedrive

• Erfahrung mit Automa

Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
description:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

 

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
  • Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
  • Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.
  • Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
  • Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
  • Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident re

We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Über uns

CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.

Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.

Deine Rolle

Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.

Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.

Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.

Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Backlog und Tickets

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

  • Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

  • Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

Konzeption

  • Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

  • Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

  • Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

Planung und Steuerung

  • Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

  • Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordinat

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
YGO.ai is a VC-funded AI tourism platform. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our cloud platform, the APIs our enterprise clients run on and the company itself.


🛡️ About this role. The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.

The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.

We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

  • Application security. Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

  • Detection and response. Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

  • Cloud and platform hardening. Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

  • The security of our APIs. Authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, token scoping and lifecycle, abuse prevention, enterprise SSO and the audit trail our clients and our own accountability depend on

  • The security of our AI systems. Prompt injection, tool and agent permissions, our MCP server, retrieval and data ingestion. The data-residency rules we are held to contractually

  • Identity and company security. SSO, MFA and privileged access for employees, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MDM, endpoint security and SaaS access. The practical IT security a company our size needs done, not discussed

  • Secure design across the pods. Threat mod

description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC).

Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris.

 La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes.

Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde.

L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: Eleve

description:
Über adconova

Effizienz²

Deine Experten für Technical FinOps und AI Coaching

Gegründet im Jahr 2021, bündelt adconova tiefgreifendes Expertenwissen aus den Bereichen Cloud und DevOps, um die digitale Transformation greifbar und messbar zu machen. Mit unserem Team agieren wir deutschlandweit als strategischer Partner für Unternehmen, die technologische Exzellenz mit wirtschaftlicher Vernunft vereinen wollen.

Unsere Kernkompetenzen:

- Technical FinOps: Wir bringen Transparenz in komplexe Cloud-Strukturen und optimieren Ihre Ausgaben durch präzises Kosten-Monitoring und Effizienzanalysen gebündelt mit technischer Umsetzung von Anpassungen.

- AI Empowerment & Coaching: Wir professionalisieren den Einsatz generativer KI dort, wo der echte Mehrwert entsteht – direkt am Arbeitsplatz Ihrer Mitarbeitenden. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Befreiung von Routinetätigkeiten durch maßgeschneiderte „Side-by-Side“-Lösungen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzeption und Aufbau virtueller Netzwerke, Routing-Konzepte, Firewalls und sicherer Anbindungen zwischen Rechenzentren, Kunden und Partnern sowie Cloud-Plattformen

  • Arbeit auf Plattformen, wie Google Cloud Platform oder auch AWS, Azure, AliBaba Cloud oder hybriden Umgebungen

  • Du definierst Architekturvorgaben, Sicherheitsrichtlinien und technische Standards und stellst deren Einhaltung über alle Beteiligten hinweg sicher

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte für Netzwerksegmentierung, Verschlüsselung, Zugriffskontrollen und sichere Cloud-Anbindungen und bewertest neue Technologien hinsichtlich ihrer Risiken

  • Du koordinierst interne Stakeholder:innen, DevOps-Teams sowie externe Dienstleistungsunternehmen und sorgst für ein gemeinsames Verständnis der Architektur- und Sicherheitsanforderungen

  • Mitarbeit an Kundenprojekten im Kontext Technical FinOps, Cloud Governance, Architektur, Kubernetes, Migrationsstrategien, AI Plattformen

Was Du mitbringst

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung als Cloud Architect mit Schwerpunkt auf Google Cloud Platform und Netzwerken, oder einer anderen Public Cloud

  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Cloud- und DevOps-Strukturen

  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit zwischen Fachbereichen und Cloud-Teams und verstehst es, Anforderungen in tragfähige Architekturkonzepte zu übersetzen

  • Erfahrungen mit modernen KI-Technologien (vgl. GenAI, Claude, Gemini, MS Copilot, ChatGPT, OpenWebUI)

  • Analytische Stärke und Begeisterung für technische Effizienz

  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch

title: Sales Development Representative - French Speaking (Europe)
description:
Location: Remote in Europe

Salary: Competitive base + Commission

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

About the Role 🤔

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.

  • Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.

  • Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent,

Customs AI Integration & Automation Engineer (France)
description:
About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

The Role

You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.

This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.

You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.

Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.

• Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business

• Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.

• Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

.

Requirements

Essential

• 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.

• Strong Python and SQL, with production c

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the role

0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers.

Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes:

  • Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet

  • Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes

  • Kubernetes clusters and managed databases

  • A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps

All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs.

What you'll own

You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill.

  • Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses.

  • Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity.

  • Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades.

  • Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap.

  • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps.

  • Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems.

  • Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet.

  • Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning.

  • Deve

title: MTS: AI Research Engineer
description:
Type: Full Time, Hybrid

Team: Research

Focus: AI & Agent Systems

Who We Are

We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era.

Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here - we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition.


Who We Are Not

  • We are not remote. We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings.

  • We are not your typical team. It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special.

  • We are not another “polished” SF startup. We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful.

What You’ll Own & Build

As a Member of Technical Staff within the Research Tribe, you’ll be one of the early engineers shaping the core systems that power Seldon.

You won’t just build agents - you’ll design the infrastructure that governs how they operate: how they coordinate, how they’re evaluated, and how their behavior improves over time.

This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product - turning stochastic models into reliable, production-grade systems.

  • Multi-Agent Systems Architecture: Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. You’re building a long-running harness-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls.

  • Behavioral & Persona

title: Sustainability solutions consultant (french & german speaking)
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We're looking for more early members to join our Sustainability solutions team! You may be a fit for this role if you’re excited to help Europe's largest companies deliver real decarbonisation, navigate an increasingly complex landscape of investor pressure, customer expectations and regulatory requirements. You’re willing to roll your sleeves up and go deep with prospective customers on their functional and technical needs, partnering with our sales, product and climate science teams along the way. You may be a carbon accounting aficionado or you may have never worked in climate before but have a passion for the subject; either way, you have a knack for quickly learning new, complex topics and distilling them for others.


You will:

  • Partner closely with 3-4 Account Executives, to analyse and understand customers’ businesses, climate ambitions and software needs

  • Become a trusted advisor to our prospective customers—educating them about corporate climate commitments, carbon accounting, regulation/policy and the Watershed offering

  • Build and share subject matter expertise on how the world’s largest companies can run successful climate programs

  • Demonstrate Watershed’s unique value to prospective customers, through product demonstrations, ROI analysis and customer stories

  • Creatively apply the Agentic AI capabilities of the Watershed platform to address innovative use cases

  • Scope complex customer engagements as Watershed expands to new industries

  • Interface with Customer Success and Sustainability Advisory teams to ensure smooth handovers from pre- to post-contract

  • Collaborate with Watershed’s Engineering, Product and Marketing teams to continuo

title: Technical Product Owner mit Entwickler-Background 100 % (w/m/d)
description:
Das sind wir

Die One of One Group GmbH vereint mit der YOU MAWO GmbH und Additive Scale GmbH führende Unternehmen im Bereich digitaler, maßgefertigter Eyewear und additiver Fertigung. Wir entwickeln und produzieren individuell angepasste Brillen auf Basis präziser 3D-Modelle und datengetriebener Prozesse. Dabei verbinden wir Design, eigene Softwarelösungen und industrielle additive Fertigung zu einer skalierbaren Plattform für Product Customization.

Wir suchen ab sofort für unseren Standort: München, Konstanz, Berlin oder remote in Deutschland

Deine Mission

Du hast selbst Software entwickelt und willst jetzt mitbestimmen, was gebaut wird und warum, ohne den Bezug zum Wie zu verlieren. Als Technical Product Owner verbindest du Business-Anforderungen und technische Umsetzung. Mit deinem agilen Entwicklerteam sprichst du auf Augenhöhe: Du diskutierst Lösungsansätze und triffst technische Richtungsentscheidungen selbst.

Du startest in einem eingespielten Umfeld. Unsere Entwicklungs- und Release-Prozesse funktionieren, und für die Makro-Architektur gibt es einen Software-Architekten. Deine Ideen für Verbesserungen sind jedoch immer willkommen. Deine Energie fließt in Produkt, Technik und KI-Innovation.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Product Ownership & Backlog: Du hast Verantwortung für das Product Backlog, schreibst präzise User Stories und priorisiert Features. Dabei wägst du schnellen Business-Value (Time-to-Market) und technische Qualität (Tech-Debt) bewusst und begründet gegeneinander ab.

  • Technische Entscheidungen auf Augenhöhe: Innerhalb der vorgegebenen Makro-Architektur (GCP, Microservices) gestaltest du das „Wie” im Detail mit, zum Beispiel API-Design, Datenstrukturen, Payloads, Frontend/Backend- Kommunikation und Komponentenschnitt. Du entscheidest selbst oder erarbeitest Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Entwicklern.

  • KI-Integration & Produktinnovation: Du bewertest, wo Generative AI, LLMs und Machine Learning unseren Produkten echten Mehrwert bringen. Diese Features bringst du pragmatisch und nutzerzentriert in unsere bestehenden Systeme.

  • Schnittstelle & Übersetzer: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Software-Architekt, Entwickler Team, Produktmanagement und Geschäftsführung zusammen und übersetzt zwischen diesen Welten.

  • Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du bringst Impulse ein, um bewährte Abläufe gezielt zu verbessern.

Dein Profil

  • Entwickler-Background (Muss): Du hast mehrere Jahre praktisch als Softwareentwickler gearbeitet, idealerweise im Web-Umfeld (z. B. Java, Python oder Angular).

  • Produkt-Erfahrung: Du hast erste Erfahrung als (Technical) Product Owner, Tech Lead mit Produktverantwortung oder Product-Minded Engineer im agilen Umfeld.

  • Ausbildun

About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. title: Senior Software/AI Engineer
description:
EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU & UK)

The Role

A very strong senior software engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and operating production systems. We hire for engineering strength first: people who write good software, reason about failure, and own what they ship.

You will work in a team of 2 to 6 engineers on a client project. Clients come to us because we work at the forefront of AI in the enterprise; you help implement our AI strategy.

AI experience is required. Much of our work involves LLM-powered and agentic systems, and while you may not be working directly on LLMs, you will be working on LLM based systems.

What We're Looking For

  • Are strong on the frontend and can build genuinely complex UI

title: Staff Software Engineer - Robotics Platform
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the Job

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, architect the communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. The main focus will be on the design, implementation and maintenance of essential parts of the on-robot platform, contributing to open source projects where feasible. With your outstanding skills, you will be a role model for other developers in our organisation and guide them on their professional journey. 


What you'll do

  • Collaborate closely with engineers from other teams  to derive requirements and help shape the vision of our robotics platform 

  • Derive roadmaps towards our vision, incorporating business needs and handling conflicting timelines and requirements

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. health monitoring and machine configuration management. Guide junior team members to support your endeavors

  • Monitor external dependencies and alternatives to assess potential issues or improvements

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
description:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbei

title: Senior Product Security Engineer  - Remote working within Germany
Senior Software Engineer — ML Inference & Numerics
description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You'll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You'll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We're looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You'll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you'll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.

title: Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Australia or New Zealand)

Type: Full-time, remote

About Neuphonic

Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications.

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.

Why we're hiring

As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on.

We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems.

A key part of this role is extending our production support coverage beyond UK working hours. We're hiring in Australia or New Zealand to help us work towards 24/7 support for our production customers, so we're looking for someone comfortable taking ownership of live systems, responding to incidents, and making independent technical decisions.

Importantly, this isn't just about keeping our systems running. We want someone who will actively look for ways to improve how we build, deploy, and serve our models, continually experimenting, optimising, and evolving our infrastructure as we scale.

What you'll own

  • Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.

  • Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo.

  • Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements.

  • Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond

title: Software Engineer - Database
description:
About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.
