title: VP, Finance
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

About the Role

The VP, Finance will own financial strategy, performance and capital allocation across the group and its businesses. Finance should provide a clear view of where the group is making money, where capital is being deployed and where returns can be improved.

 

What you will be doing

  • Own Group P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, budgeting and financial planning.

  • Build financial models for businesses, new products, market expansion and investments.

  • Review revenue, costs, margins, unit economics and cash requirements by business.

  • Drive capital allocation based on business performance and expected returns.

  • Own treasury, tax, audit, controls and financial reporting across Group entities.

  • Lead financing, investments, acquisitions and other transactions when required.

  • Build finance systems and teams that can support additional businesses and markets.

 

What you will need

  • Senior finance experience in technology, fintech, internet or another high-growth business.

  • Strong experience across corporate finance, FP&A and business finance.

title: Senior Software Engineer (YDB Team)

Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Über QualityMinds

Die QualityMinds GmbH ist ein agiles Unternehmen für Qualitätssicherung, Softwaretest und Softwareentwicklung. Kontinuierliches Lernen, Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung prägen unseren Arbeitsalltag. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Platform Engineer (m/w/d) für Nürnberg, München oder deutschlandweit remote.

Du begeisterst dich für Kubernetes, Cloud-Native-Technologien, CI/CD, GitOps und Infrastructure as Code? Du möchtest moderne Plattformen auf Basis von Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, OpenTofu und Ansible gestalten und dabei eng mit unseren Kund:innen zusammenarbeiten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze uns bei der Entwicklung, Modernisierung und dem Betrieb zukunftsfähiger Cloud- und Plattformlösungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei der Analyse komplexer technischer Anforderungen und entwickelst daraus im Team zukunftsfähige Lösungs- und Plattformarchitekturen.

Du betreibst moderne Cloud-, Kubernetes- und Container-Plattformen – sowohl On-Premises als auch in der Cloud.

Du entwickelst und optimierst skalierbare CI/CD- und GitOps-Prozesse und treibst die Automatisierung von Entwicklungs- und Betriebsabläufen voran.

Du begleitest Modernisierungs- und Migrationsprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden.

Deine Qualifikationen

Du bringst eine Fachausbildung oder ein Fachstudium mit (interdisziplinärer Berufshintergrund ist willkommen).

Du bringst Erfahrung mit modernen IT-Cloud- und Plattformlösungen mit.

Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Cloud-Native-Technologien sowie dem Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen.

Du setzt moderne Cloud-Plattformen (Azure/On-Premises Kubernetes) ein, beherrscht Infrastructure-as-Code-Methoden und die passenden Tools (Terraform, OpenTofu oder Ansible) und bist routiniert im Aufbau und Betrieb automatisierter CI/CD-Pipelines.

Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1 Level) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Dich zeichnen Kommunikationsstärke, Freude am direkten Austausch und ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität aus.

Du arbeitest gerne proaktiv im Team und überzeugst gleichzeitig durch eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

Du hast Spaß daran, Neues zu entdecken, unterschiedliche Menschen kennenzulernen und deine Expertise dort einzubringen, wo sie gebraucht wird.

Deine Benefits bei QualityMinds

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit hybrides Arbeiten

  • Arbeitsmöglichkeiten in unseren modernen Offices

  • Familienfreundliches Umfeld

  • Chancen eigene Themen miteinzubringen

  • Wir bieten dir individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, für die Ausübung eines Ehrenamtes, fünf Arbeitstage freizunehmen

  • Regelmäßige

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction

title: Sales Engineer (m/w/d) - B2B Software & Physical AI
description:
Standort: Osnabrück / Hybrid / Remote (Deutschland)
Start: Ab sofort
Anstellung: Vollzeit

Bring Physical AI in die Industrie und gestalte unseren Vertrieb aktiv mit.

Bei ONE WARE verkaufst du nicht einfach Software. Du gewinnst Unternehmen für innovative KI-Lösungen, begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Abschluss und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns die Vertriebsstrategie weiter. Dabei übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung und gestaltest das Wachstum eines jungen Technologieunternehmens mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du identifizierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden, sprichst sie aktiv an und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

  • Du entwickelst unser Sales Playbook weiter, testest neue Akquisekanäle und findest heraus, welche Strategien funktionieren.

  • Du zeigst Unternehmen, wie unsere KI-Technologie konkrete Herausforderungen in der industriellen Bildverarbeitung löst.

  • Du begleitest Kunden eigenständig vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du erschließt neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und gewinnst strategische Partner, insbesondere Gerätehersteller.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits selbst Kunden gewonnen, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.

  • Du gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, scheust keine Kaltakquise und setzt eigene Ideen um.

  • Du begeisterst dich für KI, Software oder Automatisierung und kannst technische Lösungen verständlich erklären.

  • Du entwickelst eigene Vertriebsansätze, probierst Neues aus und möchtest ein Unternehmen aktiv voranbringen.

  • Du überzeugst Kunden, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und arbeitest zielorientiert.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, sicher Englisch und bist bereit, innerhalb der DACH-Region zu reisen.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production.   • Scope and run proofs-of-concept against clear, shared success criteria, guiding customers all the way to production

Health can’t wait.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits. title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral is looking for AI Scientists with deep ML expertise and hands-on engineering experience to expand what our agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle — CAE (CFD, FEA, etc.) and EDA/Semi.

Working within the AI4Engineering Science team, your core work is building the pre and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Because Mistral trains its own frontier LLMs, the data and verifiers you design ship directly into models you can hold, a rare position, and the core of the job.

Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harness that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.

You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA or other domains to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.

This is early-stage work, and that's the point: you'd be joining at the foundation, shaping the data, verifiers, and agent scaffolding that decide whether these systems become reliable or stay demo-grade. There's no inherited playbook, you'll help define what good looks like, and your work will set the direction the team builds on rather than extend an existing one.

title: Staff Engineer | Voyagu
description:
Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

title: Recruitment Partner
description:
Who we are

hirehire agency is built around deep product and design expertise. Our expert network is made up of senior designers and PMs who have worked at companies like Intercom, Stripe, Revolut, and others. They interview and evaluate like practitioners – because they’ve done the job. That’s what sets us apart from the typical agency.

Our clients include JetBrains, Replika, Recraft, Sentry, Toloka, Nebius, White Circle, Manychat, Capital.com, TripleTen, Pleo, Emerging Travel Group, Solidroad, and others.

What’s at our core

Three pillars everything revolves around:

  • Clients – they need the right person, fast.

  • Experts – they evaluate candidates with a practitioner’s eye.

  • Talent – people with their own goals and pace, not a line on a resume.

A Recruiting Partner holds all three at once: hearing the client’s request, listening to the candidate, guiding and supporting the expert. This is deep, partner-like work with people – like leading a dance, everyone moving in the same direction.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own each search end-to-end – from brief to offer, including timelines, quality, and communication. Interviews are run by our experts.

What you need to succeed

  • 3+ years of recruiting experience, ideally in fast-paced tech environments.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. And we’re a long way from done!

title: Sales Engineer (EMEA)

About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

 

Role Overview

As a Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical components of the sales process. You will partner closely with Account Executives and prospective customers to design integration approaches, evaluate technical fit, and demonstrate how Constructor’s platform drives measurable business impact.

This role combines technical architecture design, consultative discovery, and cross-functional collaboration. You will act as a bridge between customer engineering teams and Constructor’s Product and Engineering teams.

This is not a demo-heavy role. Account Executives perform the majority of demonstrations at Constructor. This role requires architectural thinking, integration planning, and consultative problem-solving.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales & Solution Design

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

About Quandela

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

Requirements

  • Enrollment for the whole duration of the internship in a MSc in Physics, Telecom/Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Quantum Technologies or related fields. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement.
  • Minimal duration is 5 months. Shorter internship will not be accepted.
  • Ideal starting date late Summer 2026.
  • General knowledge of integrated photonics modelling and layout
  • Python, Git, Lumerical, simulation tools (FDTD, mode solver, EME..)
  • Great skills in data analysis
  • Capability of working in a team
  • Strong communication skills in English and French

Benefits

  • 50% participation in transportation costs 🚆
  • Possibility of remote work 💻
  • Internship Allowance between €1,200 and €1,400 per month 💰

A challenging and innovative work environment at the heart of quantum computing. <

title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact

Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen, eingebettet in deren Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt ist das Backend mit C# und .NET: fachliche Logik, Datenbanken und die Schnittstellen zu anderen Systemen.

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du im .NET-Backend und in SQL Server sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Fachlichkeit reinfindest.

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser.

title: Working Student – Quality & Data (m/f/d)
description:
About JawBuddy

JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.

We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.

The role

You make sure our app and our numbers can be trusted, and you use AI to do it at a scale one person couldn't before. AI handles the repetitive checks; you handle what needs human judgment, like testing our camera features in the real world.

  • You work directly with our CTO and founding engineer (~12h)

  • Data quality (~5h)

  • Automation with AI (~3h)

What you'll do

  • Test our computer vision in the real world

  • Test camera-based jaw tracking across devices, lighting, faces, glasses and beards

  • Find the conditions where measurements break, and help the team fix them

  • Own app quality

  • Own the release checklist for every iOS and Android build

  • Test accessibility, German texts, performance, slow networks and offline use

  • Write clear bug reports in Linear, with steps to reproduce and evidence

  • Keep test evidence documented, as our product requires

  • Keep our data trustworthy

  • Review the daily data-quality checks across Amplitude, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat and BigQuery, and investigate what they flag

  • Find out why two tools disagree, and get it fixed

  • Keep our tracking plan in sync with what the app actually sends

  • Automate with AI

  • Use AI tools to write automated tests (Maestro), generate test cases and run checks

  • Review what AI produces: you are the person who decides whether it is right

What you bring

  • Enrolled student, available 15–20 hours a week for at least 12 months

  • Fluent in English (the app is in German; the team works in English)

  • Solid SQL

  • A structured, curious way of testing: you find the edge cases others miss

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your daily work

Nice to have

  • Test automation (Maestro, Detox, Appium)

  • Accessibility (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack)

  • Product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) or attribution (AppsFlyer)

  • dbt or Dataform, Git, Python

  • Interest in computer vision, health tech or medical device quality

What we offer

  • Real ownership

  • You own the release checklist, and when you say a build isn't ready, we listen.

  • Work with AI from day one

  • You learn how to run quality at scale with AI, a skill

title: Principal of backend
description:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | SRE (Remote, EU/CET)
description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build secure, reliable, and scalable systems as Maze grows.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚 Our Marketing team

No one is more creative and data-driven than this team; they truly combine the best of both worlds. The Marketing team’s mission is to put our product into the hearts and hands of millions of users around the world.

  • The Campaign & Merchandising Team drives our B2C campaign calendar and elevates the shopping experience.

  • The B2B Marketing Team positions Joko as the top partner in our space and builds a standout employer brand.

Led by Isa, our CMO, the team is constantly innovating to take the business to new heights.

🎯 What you will do

As CRM & Lifecycle Manager, your mission is to design and run lifecycle programs that turn new signups into engaged, loyal, high-LTV Joko users. You will own the end-to-end CRM strategy across in-app, push, and email from the first onboarding message to the campaign that reactivates dormant users. You will join the Growth team, report to the VP Growth, and partner daily with Product, Data, and Brand teams.

Your main missions will be:

  • Guide new users to their first Joko “wow” moment: The first days shape everything that follows. You’ll design the onboarding journey: messaging, timing, and triggers so every new user feels understood and reaches activation quick

title: GTM Lead, APAC
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role

Higgsfield AI is looking for a GTM Lead, APAC to build and own our commercial business across Asia-Pacific (excluding Japan, which has its own dedicated lead). APAC is already one of our largest regions by creators and generations; this role turns that usage into agency, brand and enterprise revenue.

You will define the APAC go-to-market, source and close the region's first lighthouse accounts yourself, open the partner routes to market that matter in Asia, and set the playbook that the next wave of APAC hires will follow. You will work closely with our Asia-based Growth team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

The ideal candidate has sold creative, marketing or AI technology across at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures, knows when a partner is the right route in and when direct is, and is energised by owning a region from zero.

What you'll do

Open the APAC market

  • Build and execute Higgsfield's APAC go-to-market strategy, tiered by market: active selling in Singapore, Australia and New Zealand, Korea and Hong Kong; relationship building in Southeast Asia, India and Taiwan; later investment elsewhere.

  • Segment the region by readiness to buy: advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers, K-content, gaming and sports media.

  • Personally source, run and close the region's first enterprise and agency deals, from first touch through negotiation and signature, adapting to how each market buys: procurement-led in ANZ, relationship-first in Korea and Greater China, partner-led and price-sensitive in Southeast Asia and India.

  • Convert high-usage APAC creators, teams and agencies already on the platform into team and enterprise accounts.

Build pipeline and revenue

  • Own APAC pipeline, forecast and bookings; keep 3x+ pipeline coverage and report weekly to leadership.

Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle technische Kundenanfragen, analysierst komplexe Problemstellungen und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Gleichzeitig optimierst du unsere operativen Abläufe und gestaltest den weiteren Aufbau unseres Customer-Operations-Bereichs.

Die Position verbindet technischen 2nd-Level-Support und operatives SaaS-Kundenmanagement.

2nd-Level-Support & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Du übernimmst komplexe technische und funktionale Kundenanfragen, die über unseren First-Level-Support hinausgehen.

  • Du unterstützt unser Support-Team bei besonders anspruchsvollen Fällen und gibst dein technisches Wissen aktiv weiter.

Customer Operations & Technische Bestandskundenbetreuung

  • Du unterstützt unsere Bestandskunden bei komplexeren Konfigurationen, individuellen Anforderungen und der optimalen Nutzung unserer SaaS-Plattformen.

  • Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Anfragen von Administratoren und Kundenverantwortlichen.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Projektmanagement für eine strukturierte Übergabe neuer Kunden in die laufende Betreuung.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our sales funnel. You will be the first point of contact for many of our future customers: fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions looking to modernise their compliance operations.

Your mission will be to identify, engage and qualify high-potential prospects, and to book meetings for our Account Executives. You will work hand in hand with Sales and the Growth team to test new outreach strategies, sharpen our messaging and turn what works into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The position is based in London, with a hybrid remote policy.

  • Prospect & qualify leads: identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Engineering Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.

You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.

This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Our client is an established, family-owned industrial technology company headquartered near Zurich. Its systems run at customer sites in more than 60 countries. To keep them reachable and secure, it needs someone who can build and run the networks behind them, and who is comfortable intervening and troubleshooting when a customer's connection goes down.

What you'll do

  • Set up, run and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote-access VPNs to customer sites (IPsec, OpenVPN)

  • Configure and maintain firewalls (Fortinet, OPNsense and others)

  • Design and implement networks at customer sites: switching, routing, VLANs, WLAN

  • Find and fix network problems together with customers and colleagues around the world, remotely or on site

  • Install and roll out software on Windows and Linux systems

  • Build and maintain the internal test and lab networks

  • Keep network documentation clear and up to date, and help improve how the team works


What you bring

  • A completed IT or electrical engineering education (EFZ with further training, HF, FH or equivalent)

  • At least three years of hands-on experience in network or system engineering

  • Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching and firewalls

  • Real experience with VPNs, ideally IPsec and OpenVPN

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server

  • A calm, customer-focused way of solving problems, including under pressure

  • Fluent German and English

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site work

Nice to have

  • Linux administration

  • Scripting or automation (Python, Bash)

  • Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or Fortinet NSE

  • A background in network or cyber security

What's on offer

  • Room to shape the role and how things are done

  • Flexible working model with home office (up to 60%)

  • Individual training and certification budget

  • Comprehensive social benefits

  • A long-term position in a stable, family-owned company

title: Senior Software Engineer
Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

  • €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales & Business Development
description:
Bist Du bereit, als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales & Business Development unseren Vertriebsprozess gemeinsam mit unseren beiden Gründer:innen auszubauen und umzusetzen?

Bei uns dreht sich alles darum, unsere Kunden am Puls der Zeit in die KI-Welt zu begleiten: Beginnend bei KI-Trainings, über KI-Workshops, MVPs bis hin zu Production-Ready Entwicklungsprojekten at scale.   • Du übernimmst in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Gründer:innen die Verantwortung für unseren Akquiseprozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum vereinbarten Erstgespräch

  • Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, etwa für Recherche, Personalisierung von Ansprachen oder die Auswertung Deiner Ergebnisse, und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wo KI den Prozess effizienter machen kann. Mit unserem Team entwickelst du gemeinsam Automatisierungen, die Dich in Deiner Arbeit unterstützen

  • Du pflegst unser CRM und unterstützt bei Bedarf auch nach dem Erstgespräch, zum Beispiel bei der Vorbereitung von Kundenterminen oder der Erstellung und Nachverfolgung von Angeboten

Qualifikation

title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
description:
The Challenge

We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.

A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.

Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

This is a remote opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own call quality holistically: hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

  • Manage zones, codes, and origins: own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

  • Update routing continuously: change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

  • Work cross-functionally by design: partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

  • Move routing toward automation: work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.


What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border

title: Account Executive Nordics
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

title: Community Lead | Multiple Langs
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

LILT is building speech and language datasets for AI in five languages: Balochi, Guarani, Luxembourgish, Turkmen and Uyghur. We are looking for Community Leads who are active in these language communities to help connect speakers with paid recording and transcription work.

A Community Lead is someone the community already knows and trusts. You might run a cultural society or academy, teach the language, edit a publication, host a radio show, or manage an online group.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Share LILT opportunities with speakers in your community

- Refer speakers through the Community Lead referral form

- Be our point of contact for questions from your community

- Take on paid recording or transcription work yourself, if you want to (optional)

HOW YOU EARN

- A referral bonus for each speaker you refer who completes approved work

- A growth bonus once 10 of your referrals are active

- Full payment details are in the Community Lead agreement you receive once approved

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Fluent speaker of Balochi, Guarani, Luxembourgish, Turkmen or Uyghur

- A recognized role in your language community, such as society or academy head, teacher, editor, radio host or group admin

- Good working English to communicate with our team

- Comfortable sharing posts and answering questions from people in your community

HOW IT WORKS

Community Lead is by invitation. After you apply:

1 - We review your application

2 - You have a short call with our Talent team, including a check of your role or organization

3 - You sign the Community Lead agreement

4 - You start referring speakers through the Community Lead form

WHAT TO CONSIDER BEFORE APPLYING

- This is an independent contractor role paid on results. Payments depend on approved work by the speakers you refer. There are no benefits and earnings are not guaranteed.

- Please tell us about your role. If you work for a government or public institution, follow your employer's rules on outside paid work.

- Everyone you refer must be 18 or older.

- Participation is voluntary. We do not publish a list of Community Leads.

title: Project Manager, Gaming Localization Production
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Project Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of a large-scale localization program for a multinational gaming publisher. This customer ships localized content across dozens of titles, platforms and languages, and the program spans in-game text, marketing and UA content, cinematics and trailers, and supporting print and digital collateral.

You'll act as a key operational point of contact for the account, coordinating linguists, DTP and video specialists, and internal stakeholders to hit release-critical deadlines.   • Manage high-volume, high-stakes workstreams within the account, building strong customer relationships and driving overall customer satisfaction.

  • Build and maintain project schedules and resourcing plans across Workfront, Google sheets, and JIRA.

  • Manage content intake, review cycles and publishing workflows in coordination with the customer's content and web teams.

  • Use LILT-proprietary AI localization tools and build/maintain customer-specific translation memories and termbases to maintain consistency and leverage acros

Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. 


Hier krijg jij energie van


Tijdens deze stage van een half jaar (startende in februari) ga je aan de slag met de uitrol van Business Control binnen onze R&D-afdeling, waar dit op dit moment nog niet aanwezig is. Wij geloven dat het geluk van de mens hem zit in het hebben van autonomie, een doel (purpose) en de kans om te groeien. Business control heeft daar een enorme impact op! Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business!

Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten:

  • De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen;

  • Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews);

  • Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling;

  • Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen.


Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol 


Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijntjes te kleuren, initiatief te nemen en daardoor dus graag aan de slag gaat met nieuwe inzichten en projecten. Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig en ben je van nature erg nieuwsgierig.

title: Technical Project Manager (EMEA)
description:
About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work.

You will:

• Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation.

• Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

description:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes.

Department: Customer Success
Location: Remote (DE based) or in one of our office locations (Lisbon, Breda or Cape Town) Contract Type: Full-time (12-month freelance contract, with a view to permanent)
Language Requirement: Fluent German (native speaker)

About RoomRaccoon

RoomRaccoon is an award-winning, all-in-one hotel management system (HMS) on a mission to revolutionize the way independent hotels operate. Since our founding in 2017, we've grown to a global team of 110+ Raccooners, proudly serving over 2,000 hotels across Europe, the US, and Africa. Our culture is bold, innovative, and passionate — just like the hoteliers we support.

Tasks

The Role: Your North Star as a Customer Success Manager

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will be at the heart of RoomRaccoon’s mission — helping our hotel partners achieve maximum value from our solutions while identifying growth opportunities. You will be the trusted advisor and commercial partner to a portfolio of German-speaking hoteliers, supporting them through strategic consultation, product education, and data-driven upsell initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Success & Strategic Account Management

  • Serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of hotel clients, ensuring their success throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and create success plans to assess product usage, uncover growth opportunities, and align with client goals.
  • Deliver product training and strategic workshops that empower hoteliers to optimize operations using RoomRaccoon.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Product, and Support to ensure a seamless customer journey.

2. Commercial Growth & Upselling

  • Take ownership of renewal processes within your account portfolio, ensuring timely and successful contract renewals.
  • Proactively identify opportunities within your portfolio for tier upgrades or product add-ons (e.g., Payments, RevPlus or other modules or features).
  • Present and demo product add-ons and new features in a consultative, value-driven manner.
  • Track account health, engagement metrics, and usage data to uncover untapped revenue potential.

3. Retention & Risk Mitigation

  • Monitor customer satisfaction, usage trends, and feedback to detect risks of churn early.
  • Develop and execute proactive retention strategies to address pain points before they escalate.
  • Maintain a customer-first mindset while confidently guiding conversations toward win-win solutions.

Requirements

About You

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native or fluent in German, with professional proficiency in Eng

title: E-Mail Marketing / Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:
NUR VOLLZEIT!

Du lebst Marketing, kennst Klaviyo in- und auswendig und willst die Person sein, ohne die bei gestandenen D2C-Brands keine Mail rausgeht?

Klingt gut? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Hey, wir sind Bendt Brothers. Zwei Brüder, ein Fokus: E-Mail-Marketing wieder sexy machen. Weg von Rabatt-Spam und Template-Langeweile, hin zu Mails, auf die sich Kunden freuen und die richtig verkaufen.

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht am Fließband. Es geht nicht darum, Tickets abzuhaken, damit die nächste Mail rausgeht, egal wie sie performt.

Stattdessen trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden neue Rekorde aufstellen, Grenzen verschieben und ihre eigenen Erwartungen übertreffen.

Und das nicht für irgendwelche Shops, sondern für Marken, die du wirklich kennst: mymuesli, Pammys, zeroLabs, Supernaturals, FAVLY und viele mehr.

Aufgaben

Hast du Bock auf verstaubte Asana-Boards, chaotische Excel-Listen und endlose Calls, nach denen keiner weiß, wer was macht?

Wir auch nicht.

Was du stattdessen machst:

  • Du behältst alle Projekte im Blick, briefst unser Design-Team und sorgst dafür, dass jede Mail pünktlich rausgeht.

  • Du schreibst Copy, die trifft und verkauft.

  • Du baust Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups in Klaviyo und bespielst auch WhatsApp und Print-Mailings.

  • Du arbeitest mit modernen KI-Systemen, die dir die Fleißarbeit abnehmen.

Qualifikation

Fähigkeiten & Erfahrung

  • Du arbeitest seit mindestens 1 Jahr intensiv mit Klaviyo und hast Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups schon selbst gebaut.

  • Du hast bereits Copywriting-Erfahrung und schreibst Texte, die verkaufen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und behältst auch bei vielen Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick.

  • Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift ist unerlässlich.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im E-Commerce oder aus einer Agentur mit.

Einstellung & Herangehensweise

  • Du übernimmst 100% Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse.

  • Du denkst in Lösungen statt in Problemen und gibst dich nicht mit Mittelmaß zufrieden.

  • Du liebst es, dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du willst, dass unsere Kunden erfolgreich sind, und gehst dafür auch mal die Extrameile.

Benefits

Was dich als Teil von Bendt Brothers erwartet

  • Du arbeitest 100% remote mit klaren Prozessen.

  • Mit den Gründern direk

title: Senior SAP Logistics Consultant - Vollzeit (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER UNS:

Wir sind die 24 Log GmbH, ein innovatives und wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich der SAP Logistik. Unsere Mission ist es, die komplexen Herausforderungen der modernen Logistik mit intelligenten, zielstrebigen und benutzerfreundlichen Lösungen zu meistern. Von der Konzeption über die Realisierung und Implementierung bis hin zum flächendeckenden, internationalen Rollout und Betrieb begleiten wir Ihre Projekte gewissenhaft und zielorientiert.

Mit unseren SAP-basierten IT-Logistiklösungen und Systemintegrationen sichern wir den reibungslosen Ablauf Ihrer logistischen Prozesse und tragen dazu bei, dass Ihre Projekte erfolgreich und termingerecht abgeschlossen werden.

WIR BIETEN:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Firmenwagen: Für die Ausübung deiner Tätigkeiten stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung, damit du flexibel und komfortabel unterwegs bist - auch privat. Du hast freie Fahrzeugauswahl!

  • BIKELEASING: Du leistest dir dein Wunschfahrrad günstig über unser "Jobrad"-Programm. Umweltfreundlich und fit unterwegs – wir unterstützen dich dabei!

  • Vielfältige Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen (VWL) und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (BAV). Wir bieten dir zudem flexible Arbeitszeiten und freie Zeitgestaltung.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Unsere Arbeit lebt von einem positiven und kundenorientierten Umfeld. Nur wer selbst positiv eingestellt ist, kann auch andere begeistern.

  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeitenden erhalten ein marktgerechtes Gehalt und können von zahlreichen weiteren Leistungen profitieren. Du hast zudem die Möglichkeit, über unser partizipatives Modell fortlaufend von den Erfolgen in der Umsetzung persönlich zu profitieren.

  • Individuelle Entfaltungsmöglichkeiten: Spannende Projekte mit viel Potenzial für die eigene Entwicklung und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, das individuell eingesetzt werden darf.


DEINE AUFGABENBEREICHE:

  • Leitung von Projekten im Rahmen der S/4HANA-Transformation.

  • Entwicklung und Anpassung von komplexen SAP-Logistikmodulen nach spezifischen Kundenanforderungen.

  • Führung und Coaching von Junior Consultants und Teammitgliedern zur erfolgreichen Durchführung der Kundenprojekte.

  • Eigenständige Umsetzung und Einführung von innovativen SAP-Technologien wie FIORI/UI5 und ABAP-Entwicklung.
